title: Select Visual Identity & Architecture
question: The roll assigned Technical Reference Spec. Choose your visual world or re-roll.

options.label: Technical Reference Spec (Spec 81)
options.lineage: Bell Labs & IBM Technical Reference Manuals
options.thesis: The enterprise assistant as an authoritative reference manual — dense, permanent, sub-50ms clear.
options.viewport: Three-pane technical console: permanent index rail, live citation stream, vector inspector.
options.risk: Can feel intimidatingly dense if spacing is compressed.

raised.raise: Inspector panels float on subtle elevated acetate planes above the data stream.
Every verified RAG citation carries an indelible stamped cryptographic verification badge.

options.label: Braun Industrial Console
options.thesis: Quiet, surgical utility: high contrast, zero ornamentation, pure typographic hierarchy.
options.viewport: Unified studio dashboard with high-density card groups and instant hotkey command line.
options.risk: Familiar to modern SaaS developers; less radical departure.

options.label: Acetate Tab Board
options.lineage: Boxed software reference manuals with transparent leaves
options.thesis: Every setting and query sits on a tabbed acetate leaf hinged over the underlying vector index.
options.viewport: Stepped tab fore-edge rail down the left margin, floating data sheets in the center.
options.case: High resonance for documentation systems; distinctive physical presence.
options.risk: Layering effects must be rendered with restraint on mobile viewports.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Too experimental and coarse for enterprise security audits.
options.kept: Integer-scaled monospace telemetry numbers at display size.

canonCard.label: Modern Linear/Vercel SaaS
canonCard.thesis: The contemporary dark-mode developer tool standard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Clean sidebar with search, unified form groups, right-aligned telemetry.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other AI developer tool on GitHub.
